entities.name: Holy Book of the Confessors
entities.description: Prayer book used by Sumifa's song mages to communicate in secret, containing prophetic words.

entities.name: Samor the Collector
entities.description: Read the book in 35 AR and was puzzled by its message.

events.summary: In 35 AR Samor the Collector read the message "Fear not" in the book and was puzzled by it.
events.quote: Samor himself was puzzled by this message.
